title: Two-model or two-forecast tie-out
description: Produces independent estimates, quantifies differences, reconciles assumptions, and signs off the selected forecast.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: two-model-forecast-tieout
  title: Two-model or two-forecast tie-out
  description: Produces independent estimates, quantifies differences, reconciles assumptions, and signs off the selected forecast.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Establish a defensible forecast through independent model comparison.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 2
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - forecast-owner
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Forecast question and input data
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - question
          - inputs
          - horizon
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: model-a
      kind: agent
      name: Forecast model A
      role: Independent forecaster
      prompt: Build an estimate with assumptions, calculations, scenarios, and confidence intervals.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - simulation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: model-b
      kind: agent
      name: Forecast model B
      role: Independent forecaster
      prompt: Independently build an estimate using a distinct reasonable method where possible.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - simulation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: tieout
      name: Compare forecast outputs
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      role: Forecast reconciliation analyst
      prompt: Compare both forecasts, quantify material variance, and tie differences to methods, assumptions, inputs, and
        uncertainty. Return materialVariance and unresolved assumptions.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - simulation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        permissions:
          - read-only
    - id: reconcile
      kind: loop
      name: Reconcile material variance
      config:
        body:
          - model-a
          - model-b
          - tieout
        exitCondition: tieout.materialVariance == false
        maxIterations: 2
        onExhausted: warn
    - id: forecast-owner
      kind: approval
      name: Forecast owner selects final view
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Tie-out report and approved forecast
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: model-a
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: model-b
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: model-a
      to: tieout
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: model-b
      to: tieout
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: tieout
      to: reconcile
      kind: control
      condition: failed
    - id: e6
      from: tieout
      to: forecast-owner
      kind: control
      condition: passed
    - id: e7
      from: reconcile
      to: forecast-owner
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exhausted
    - id: e8
      from: forecast-owner
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
    - id: reconcile-exit
      from: reconcile
      to: forecast-owner
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
